name: pii-browser-ext
description: Dev tooling only: the extension ships as plain files, this manifest is never packaged.

scripts.generate:check: npm run spec:verify && npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/generated)"
scripts.lint: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for t in tests/*.mjs; do node "$t" || exit 1; done
